text: dsh-gargantua 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的动态黑洞背景插件。它通过 Cordis bundle 注册客户端模块，并把组件注入会话输入栏槽位，在会话中栏渲染《星际穿越》风格的黑洞动画；新会话和聊天阶段会按主题使用不同透明度。插件初始化时还会尝试将 DSH 外观切换为深色，随后仍可由用户手动更改。动画固定以 3840×2160 绘制，渲染不可用时显示静态海报。适合想为 DSH 会话界面添加沉浸式动态背景的用户；代码未声明 API 密钥或账户配置。

dsh-gargantua adds an animated black hole behind DSH Web conversations. It mounts the background in the conversation dock, adjusts opacity for new chats and active conversations, and follows the selected theme. On activation it attempts to enable dark appearance. No API key or account is declared.
想给 DSH 的聊天界面加一个持续播放的黑洞背景

dsh-gargantua 的功能「会话黑洞背景」：在 DSH 会话中栏挂载持续播放的黑洞动画，并按新会话或聊天阶段及当前主题调整透明度。

dsh-gargantua README · 手动安装与卸载：从 [v0.2.1 Release](https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua/releases/tag/v0.2.1) 下载 `dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz`，无需 Node.js 或自行构建。Release 附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

**Desktop：** 打开侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」，在包名或地址中粘贴下载包的绝对路径或上方下载链接，安装后点击「立即启用」。选择工作区，打开新会话查看。插件详情页可禁用或卸载。旧版需先卸载再安装新版；Desktop profile 由应用管理，不能用 CLI 修改。

**Web：** 已安装 DSH CLI 时，对实际使用的 Web profile 执行：

dsh-gargantua README · 手动安装与卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz"
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gargantua
```

若 profile 名不同，替换为当前使用的名称。根据宿主返回结果刷新或重启；不要把安装包下载成功当成插件已启用。

dsh-gargantua README · 自动切换深色：每次启用插件或启动 DSH，插件等待宿主主题设置加载后，使用官方主题接口将**整个 DSH 切为深色并保存**。每次初始化只执行一次；发送消息、切换会话不会重复切换。随后可在「设置 → 通用设置」手动改回浅色或跟随系统，停用和卸载不会恢复旧主题。下次启用或启动会再次选择深色。

这是为避免浅色聊天背景中黑洞几乎不可见。若设置只读、加载或保存失败，插件控制台会记录诊断，不反复强制切换；请在「设置 → 通用设置 → 深色」手动选择。

已有用户需升级到 v0.2.1，仓库更新不会自动替换本机插件。

dsh-gargantua README · 固定行为与兼容性：- 纯黑洞背景，无插件叠加文字、设置入口、面板或暂停操作；保留 DSH 自身界面。
- 实际绘制固定 **3840×2160**，按中栏比例校正，持续自动播放，调度上限 60fps；实际帧率取决于显卡。
- 深色新会话/聊天强度 **85% / 12%**，浅色 **30% / 8%**。
- 不读取旧暂停或画质设置，不因低动态或隐藏主动暂停。系统冻结、后台调度和显卡故障仍可能限制绘制；显卡不可用显示无文字静帧。
- 已在 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3** 验证安装、卸载、双主题、历史切换、缩放、输入选择。其他宿主版本需重新确认兼容性。
- 不调用模型、不发送消息、无 CDN 请求；卸载和会话组件销毁释放显卡资源。

安装后无背景时，先检查是否启用、是否选中工作区并打开会话，再检查硬件加速、浏览器显卡支持和插件错误。动画只挂在带 `data-conversation-scroll` 标记的会话中栏；不支持的宿主布局不会误挂到整个页面。

dsh-gargantua README · 从源码构建：需要 Node.js 22+：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua.git
cd dsh-gargantua
npm ci
npm run build

生成 `lib/client.js` 和 `dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz`。普通构建只使用仓库内 `vendor/gargantua` 固定快照，不要求相邻动画目录。维护时显式同步：

```sh
npm run sync:engine -- "<gargantua 源码目录>"
npm run build
```

同步记录版本和 SHA-256。React 由 DSH 提供，渲染依赖和回退图内嵌；接入使用 DSH 模块加载器、Cordis bundle 与 `conversation.input.dock`。

text: dsh-gargantua README · Ask AI to install：> Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua/main/INSTALL_FOR_AI.md and install and enable the Gargantua black hole plugin for me; verify that it is active when finished.

dsh-gargantua README · Ask AI to install：On Desktop rc.3, select **Creator mode** so DSH can use its official `plugin_manager`. External assistants need desktop interaction capability to install into Desktop. Terminal-only assistants can target a Web profile. Follow any approval prompts required by DSH. See [INSTALL_FOR_AI.md](INSTALL_FOR_AI.md), which includes English instructions.

dsh-gargantua README · Manual install / uninstall：Download `dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz` from [Release v0.2.1](https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua/releases/tag/v0.2.1); no Node.js or source build needed. Verify using the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

dsh-gargantua README · Manual install / uninstall：**Desktop:** Plugins → Add plugin → paste the absolute package path or download URL → Install → Enable now. Select a workspace and open a new conversation. Disable or uninstall from plugin details. Remove an older version before reinstalling. Desktop profiles are application-owned and cannot be modified using CLI.

**Web:** with DSH CLI already installed:

dsh-gargantua README · Manual install / uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz"
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gargantua
```

Replace `web` if the active Web profile has another name. Follow the host's reload/restart result. A downloaded package alone is not an installed, active plugin.

dsh-gargantua README · Automatic dark appearance：Each time the plugin activates or DSH starts, it waits for the Host theme settings, then uses the official theme service to **switch the entire DSH interface to dark and save that preference**. It runs once per initialization; sending messages and switching conversations do not trigger another switch. You can subsequently choose Light or System in Settings → General. Disabling or uninstalling keeps your current appearance. The next activation or start selects Dark again.

dsh-gargantua README · Automatic dark appearance：This prevents the black hole from disappearing against light chat surfaces. Read-only settings, loading or persistence failures produce console diagnostics without repeated enforcement. Select Settings → General → Dark manually if needed.

Existing users must upgrade to v0.2.1; repository updates do not automatically replace installed plugins.

dsh-gargantua README · Behavior / compatibility：- No added animation text, settings UI or pause controls. DSH's own interface remains available.
- Fixed actual **3840×2160**; container-aspect-corrected rays, continuous autoplay, 60fps scheduling ceiling. Actual performance depends on the GPU.
- Dark new/chat opacity **85% / 12%**; light **30% / 8%**.
- Legacy pause/quality settings are ignored. Reduced motion and visibility do not deliberately pause drawing. Freezing, background scheduling or graphics failure can interrupt it; failure displays a text-free still.
- Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3** install/uninstall, both themes, history changes, resizing, typing and selection were verified. Other host versions require compatibility checks.
- No model calls, sent messages or CDN. Component teardown/uninstall disposes graphics resources.

dsh-gargantua README · Behavior / compatibility：If absent, check activation, selected workspace, open conversation, hardware acceleration and plugin errors. The host layout must provide `data-conversation-scroll`; unsupported layouts do not attach a full-window background.

dsh-gargantua README · Build / maintain：Node.js 22+:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/2bigpig/dsh-gargantua.git
cd dsh-gargantua
npm ci
npm run build

Outputs `lib/client.js` and `dsh-gargantua-0.2.1.tgz`. Builds use the fixed in-repo engine snapshot; no adjacent checkout is needed. Explicitly synchronize from the maintenance source with:

```sh
npm run sync:engine -- "<gargantua-source-directory>"
npm run build
```

dsh-gargantua README · Build / maintain：Sync records version and SHA-256. React is host-supplied; rendering dependencies and fallback images are embedded. Integration uses DSH's module loader, Cordis bundle and `conversation.input.dock`.
